def solve(I):
    from collections import Counter
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    fg=[x for r in I for x in r if x!=bg][0]
    m=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(I) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x!=bg]
    O=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]

        if 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W: O[r][c]=fg
    # vertical line through middle mark col, full height (P3/P6 style, non-degenerate case)
    # P4/P5/P7: marks collinear vertical -> column; P1/P2... let's see which demo maps to which.
    rs=[r for r,c in m]; cs=[c for r,c in m]
    deg_row = len(set(rs))==1
    deg_col = len(set(cs))==1
    if deg_row:
        r0=m[0][0]
        paint(r0,0); paint(r0,W-1)
        for c in range(W): paint(r0,c)
    elif deg_col:
        c0=m[0][1]

        top=min(rs); bottom=max(rs)

        for c in range(left,right+1): paint(top,c); paint(bottom,c)
        for r in range(top,bottom+1): paint(r,left); paint(r,right)
    return O
